item.name: createPaymentLink(...): PaymentLink - W Redirect Link Copy

graphql.query:
mutation MyMutation {
  createPaymentLink(
    input: {
      require_phone: false
      redirect_url: "https://www.google.com/search?rlz=1C1CHBF_enUS1027US1027&sxsrf=APwXEdeiwutXGzPrUev99ItveJGYfClAxw:1681222282442&q=redirect&tbm=isch&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwj7qruHgaL-AhXVJkQIHerwBfcQ0pQJegQIFhAB&biw=2558&bih=1359&dpr=1#imgrc=18bRmQQqVidVUM"
      payment_description: "Test Payment Link Description"
      payment_name: "Test Payment Name"
      merchant_uid: "{{merchant_uid}}"
      link_name: "Test Payment Link Name"
      fee_mode: SERVICE_FEE
      currency: "USD"
      call_to_action: PAY
      amount_is_variable: false
      amount: 15000
      account_code: "123456"
      accepted_payment_methods: ALL
    }
  ) {
    require_phone
    redirect_url
    payment_name
    payment_description
    min_amount
    max_amount
    merchant_uid
    link_url
    link_name
    link_id

    is_active
    custom_success_message
    currency
    created_date
    call_to_action
    amount_is_variable
    amount
    account_code

  }
}
